name: Gide Reversi
headline: The classic disc-flipping game, on velvet.
lede: Big ivory and onyx discs on a purple or red velvet board. Play a friendly computer or a friend on the same phone. No ads, timers, or accounts.

features.title: Big, clear discs
features.body: Ivory and onyx discs with a gold rim, easy to count at a glance on a phone or tablet.

features.title: Tap a gold dot
features.body: Dots show every square where you can play. Tap one and the trapped discs turn over.

features.title: A kind opponent
features.body: Relaxed makes friendly mistakes, Steady plays a solid game, and Sharp is a real challenge.

features.title: Two players
features.body: Pass the phone back and forth to play a friend or a grandchild.

features.title: Hint and Undo
features.body: Hint lights up the strongest move. Undo takes back your move as often as you like.

features.title: Purple or red velvet
features.body: Pick the board you like best. The dark discs carry a small gold Gide G.

screenshots.alt: Gide Reversi game on purple velvet
screenshots.caption: Playing

privacy.heading: Nothing to collect.
privacy.body: Gide Reversi works without an account or an internet connection. Your game and settings are saved only on your device.

points.title: No ads
points.body: No pop-ups, banners, or videos between games.

points.title: No tracking
points.body: The app doesn't collect, share, or sell any information.

points.title: Works offline
points.body: Play anywhere, with or without a connection.

faq.a: Place a disc so that it traps a line of the other color between your new disc and one of yours. The trapped discs flip to your color. When the board fills, or neither side can move, the most discs wins.

faq.q: What happens if I can't move?
faq.a: Your turn is skipped and the message line tells you so. If neither side can move, the game ends.
It's the same classic game, also known as Reversi.

faq.q: Can I play against a person?
faq.a: Yes. Choose Two players in Settings and pass the phone after each turn.
No. There's no sign-in, and nothing leaves your device.

cta.heading: Set up a calm game.
cta.body: Gide Reversi is the classic disc-flipping game with big pieces, a friendly opponent, and no ads.
